A test that claims earlier facts exist but omits them cannot demonstrate context reuse or supported completion: mark those criteria NOT_ASSESSABLE and explain the fixture gap, not a model failure. Generic guidance can be useful without current sources; exact/current claims need approved evidence. Off-topic selection is not measured by this already-selected planner. Assess correct no-action handoff where applicable. A request for research is an intent only. Preserve unknown versus missing/false. The candidate may use documented no-action COMPLETE instead of nonexistent ABSTAIN. Do not rewrite answers.
